name: Samuel H. Smith
role: Joseph Smith’s brother and early missionary
dateNote: He was baptized in May 1829 and died at Nauvoo on 30 July 1844, about a month after his brothers Joseph and Hyrum.
importance: Section 23 calls him to exhort and strengthen the Church in April 1830. Later revelations send him to Missouri with Reynolds Cahoon (52, 61) and east with Orson Hyde (66, 75). He sat on the first Kirtland high council in February 1834 (102). Section 124 names him with Vinson Knight to preside over a bishopric at Nauvoo.
connections: He was a younger brother of Joseph and Hyrum Smith and a son of Joseph Smith Sr. and Lucy Mack Smith. His missionary companions in these sections were Reynolds Cahoon, William E. McLellin, and Orson Hyde.

sources.title: Samuel Harrison Smith, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP: born 13 Mar. 1808, Tunbridge, Vermont; baptized by Oliver Cowdery May 1829; one of the Eight Witnesses; Kirtland high council 17 Feb. 1834; Nauvoo bishop 1841; died 30 July 1844. Bare “Samuel” left out because it also begins Samuel Bent, Samuel Rolfe, and Samuel Williams.
